sentences.text:
Between:
Nandamuri Naga Venkata Brahmaji ...PETITIONER  AND The State Of Andhra Pradesh and Others ...RESPONDENT(S)
Counsel for the Petitioner:
1. KOTHA NAGA SURYA RAO Counsel for the Respondent(S):
1. GP FOR MUNCIPAL ADMN URBAN DEV  2. GP FOR REVENUE

The Court made the following:
ORDER:
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for the respondent No.2.
2.

This writ petition is filed questioning the action of the respondent No.2 Municipality in attempting to demolish the newly constructed residential building in an extent of Ac.0.10 cents bearing Sy.No.336/1 in D.No.12-4-44, Nallam Vari Street, Gunupudi Area, Bhimavaram Nandamuri Naga Venkata Brahmaji vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10775383/
1 Municipality, without issuing any notice and without giving any opportunity of hearing and without passing any order and without following any due process of law or acquiring the property under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
3.

entities.text: Bhimavaram Nandamuri Naga Venkata Brahmaji vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the other hand, the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondent No.2 relying upon the written instructions, dated 08.11.2024 submits that the respondent No.2 Authority issued the Provisional Order, dated 01.02.2023 and the Confirmation Order Notice, dated 28.02.2023 with respect to the subject property.
The respondent No.2 Municipality gave markings for laying paver blocks and road widening affected portions in the presence of the Town Surveyor.

4. In view of the above said facts and circumstances, no relief can be granted in this writ petition and however, the liberty is given to the petitioner, if so aggrieved to question the above said proceedings of the respondent No.2 Municipality as per law, if so advised .
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
Interim order, if any, deemed to have been vacated.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, Miscellaneous Petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

_ _ _ JUSTICE B KRISHNA MOHAN Dated: 08.11.2024 MSI THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE B KRISHNA MOHAN WRIT PETITION NO: 25416/2024 Dated: 08.11.2024 MSI Nandamuri Naga Venkata Brahmaji vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10775383/
